name: Reaper-MCP (xDarkzx)
ipc_mechanism: File-based atomic swap (command.json/response.json with file locking and Lua defer poll)
maturity: High (Active in 2026, rich test suite, comprehensive safety checks, undo grouping)
strengths: Atomic file IPC with flink/fcntl locking avoids port conflict issues
Robust undo_group mechanism (wraps actions inside native ReaScript Undo_BeginBlock/Undo_EndBlock)
Extensive tool registry (100+ tools for track, item, fx, midi, mix, patterns)
risks_and_limitations: Polling latency in Lua defer loop (~30ms typical roundtrip, not sub-millisecond)
Deeply coupled with REAPER Lua defer script

name: reaper-reapy-mcp (wegitor)
ipc_mechanism: Python-reapy TCP socket bridge to REAPER python interpreter
maturity: Medium (Clear modular controllers for track, fx, marker, midi, audio, master)
ram_footprint: Moderate (~60-90MB RSS due to reapy socket runtime)
compatibility: Windows, macOS, Linux (requires reapy server enabled inside REAPER)
strengths: Clean Object-Oriented controller modularization (TrackController, MIDIController, etc.)
Fast programmatic access via Python reapy wrapper
risks_and_limitations: reapy setup is notoriously brittle (requires specific Python DLL configured inside REAPER Preferences)
Frequent thread-safety crashes if reapy calls are made outside REAPER's GUI thread without inside_reaper()
Tightly tied to python-reapy, difficult to port to non-Python DAWs

name: reaper-daemon (wretcher207)
strengths: Zero network ports, purely asynchronous mailbox architecture
risks_and_limitations: Lacks formal schema, high I/O disk thrashing if unthrottled

name: daw-ai (hrubiian)
reuse_recommendation: Reference only / Candidate for high-perf Native Adapter
strengths: Memory safety and zero GC pauses (vital for audio system coexistence)
risks_and_limitations: Smaller ecosystem of high-level music theory libraries compared to Python

name: aura-daw (knobo)
maturity: High (Full open-source DAW GUI in web tech)
strengths: Modern responsive timeline UI, audio engine separation in Rust
risks_and_limitations: GPL-3.0 license prevents closed/proprietary derivative integration without open-sourcing

name: ATRI_AGENT (Tz-WIND)
strengths: Clear plugin lifecycle and tool discovery schema
risks_and_limitations: Strong copyleft AGPL-3.0 cannot be embedded directly in permissive/commercial core

name: music21 / mido / pretty_midi (Open-source Musicology)
maturity: Very High (Industry & academic standard for 15+ years)
strengths: Deepest music theory rules: roman numeral analysis, voice leading check, scale transposition, counterpoint rules
risks_and_limitations: music21 startup time is ~1.5s (should be kept in warm memory or imported lazily)
